personality.voice: Formal, appeals to multi-ethnic values and international law. Early war: desperate, survival mode. Late war: increasingly professional and confident.

successor_personality.voice: Quiet, professional. Focuses on building capability. References corps structure and training. Less political than Halilović.

priorities: Defend Sarajevo at all costs — political heart of Bosnia
Maintain enclaves (Srebrenica, Goražde, Žepa, Bihać) as evidence of sovereignty
Build offensive capability for late war counteroffensives
Maintain HRHB alliance — two-front war is fatal
red_lines: Enclaves represent Bosnian sovereignty — cannot be abandoned voluntarily
Do not provoke HRHB into war before we are ready

historical_expectations.w4: Chaos. Brigades forming from nothing. Defend what we can. 35-40% territory.
historical_expectations.w12: Stabilizing. 120+ brigades forming. Still losing ground but slower. 30-35%.
historical_expectations.w20: Parity approaching. 150k+ personnel. Fronts stabilized. Ready to probe.
historical_expectations.w40: Strong enough to counterattack in select areas. 33-38% territory. Professional army.

strategic_doctrine.notes: ARBiH corps (1st-5th) form at week 24. Before that, brigades operate under territorial defense with no formal corps structure. Cadet strategy only applies from w24+.
